historical_anchor.real_anchor: Late-sixth-century northern Chinese round-neck belted garments, bound hair and broad lamellar military silhouettes, constrained by docs/04A_HISTORICAL_BIBLE.md.
historical_anchor.fictional_transformation: The enemy ash-ceramic face and blank nameplate belong to the fictional Statue Office and its erased military registers; they are not claimed as excavated Northern Qi equipment.
historical_anchor.gameplay_purpose: Indigo player cloth, cinnabar enemy cloth, broad shoulder plates, front lamellae and the enemy mask keep allegiance and facing readable from the fixed isometric camera.
historical_anchor.anachronism_check: No Japanese katana or samurai armor, European plate armor, fantasy runes, or mature Song-and-later armor motifs were introduced. Shapes remain a deliberately broad prototype rather than an archaeological reconstruction.

geometry.rigging: Rigid fitted parts are attached to existing MakeHuman Humanoid bones by the Unity builder; no extra armature or animation clips are included.
